movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: Parabolic Charge
movelist.effect: After the targets take damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the total damage they dealt to all targets.

movelist.name: Charm
movelist.effect: Charm lowers the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Charge
movelist.effect: If the user performs an Electric Move on their next turn that deals damage, add its Damage Dice Roll an extra time to the damage. Raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Thunder Shock
movelist.effect: Thunder Shock Paralyzes the target on 17+.

abilities.name: Lunchbox
abilities.trigger: The user trades in a Food Buff
abilities.effect: The user gains a Tick of Temporary Hit Points. These Temporary Hit Points stack with any Temporary Hit Points granted by the triggering Food Buff.

abilities.name: Sequence
abilities.trigger: The user uses an Electric Attack
abilities.effect: For every Electric-Type Pokémon adjacent to the user, the triggering Attack deals an additional +3 Damage.
